title: AI question generation
description: Generate drafts from a passage, check their content and approve each question before adding it to the bank.
sourcePlaceholder: Paste the knowledge passage to base the questions on…
consent: I consent to sending this passage to an external AI provider to generate questions, and I have permission to use this content.
invalidCommand: Choose a topic/chapter, enter 20–20,000 characters, request 1–20 questions and consent to AI processing.
targetError: Topics/chapters could not be loaded. Reload the page to retry.
queued: Batch created. Generation is running in the background.
emptyDescription: Create a batch on the left or open a recent batch to continue reviewing.
loadError: Data could not be loaded, or access is no longer available. Reload to check.
processing: The batch is processing. This page updates automatically; you can return later.
failed: Generation failed. Check the configuration or create a new batch after resolving the issue.
completed: This batch is complete. Saved questions show their bank IDs below.
reviewHint: AI can make mistakes. Check the content, answers and cognitive level before approving. Only approved, selected questions are saved.
optionsHint: Four distinct choices · Select exactly one correct answer
invalidDraft: Enter question text (up to 2,000 characters), four distinct choices (up to 500 characters each) and exactly one correct answer.
editResetsApproval: Saving an edit clears the previous approval. Approve the new revision before adding it to the bank.
conflict: The draft changed or its state no longer permits this action. Fresh data has been requested; check it before continuing.
actionError: The action has not been confirmed. Check the latest state before retrying; do not create another batch while waiting for a result.
confirmTitle: Add approved questions to the bank?
confirmDescription: Save {count} selected questions into this batch's chapter. Other drafts are unchanged. You have checked their content and answers.
committed: Selected questions were saved to the bank.
